question: Can a warmed Engine allocate in a later global iteration because caller-owned observation storage (EngineState.observations, Vec::new at construction, cleared per step) meets a new per-step high-water mark on an outcome-dependent path (e.g. a lethal critical adding a death observation on a step that previously had fewer observations)?
why_unknown: Core pins 'warm' as replay of the same seed; the probes (AL-L-003/004) found no growth for Precision/Martial across 64 fresh identities, but no public fixture was found whose per-step observation count is outcome-dependent. Output storage growth is by design amortised caller-owned storage, so this is only a contract question if §3.8 'warmed engine decision-to-cast paths are allocation-free' is meant across iterations.
reopen: A fixture where one RNG outcome changes the number of observations emitted within one Engine::step/advance; measure warm-up with the low-count seed, then a high-count seed.
